scopedComparisons.originalDigitalComparatorVersion: ਨਮੋ ਨਿੱਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੇ ਕਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਦੇਵੇ ਸੁਧਰਮੇ ॥੫੪॥
ਨਮੋ ਰੋਗ ਹਰਤਾ ਨਮੋ ਰਾਗ ਰੂਪੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹੰ ਨਮੋ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੇ ॥੫੫॥
ਨਮੋ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਨੇ ਨਮੋ ਮਾਨ ਮਾਨੇ ॥ ਨਮੋ ਰੋਗ ਰੋਗੇ ਨਮਸਤੰ ਸਨਾਨੇ ॥੫੬॥
ਸਦਾ ਸਿਧਿਦਾ ਬੁਧਿਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥ ਅਧੋ ਉਰਧ ਅਰਧੰ ਅਘੰ ਓਘ ਹਰਤਾ ॥੫੯॥
ਪਰੰ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ ਪ੍ਰੋਛ ਪਾਲੰ ॥ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਿਆਲੰ ॥੬੦॥

sourceChecks.workingReading: Four distinct limits: defining garb, delusion, worldly indulgence and being enjoyed or consumed
alternatives: Neki stresses detachment and freedom from temptation in the final pair
sourceChecks.finding: All four epithets are explained. The non-enjoyed clause is a bounded educational paraphrase, not a claim that all experience of Divine joy is impossible. Chhand28 is recalled only as a contextual comparison.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Supreme master of yogis, supreme in method or wisdom of practice
sourceChecks.finding: The selected method reading and recorded union alternative have separate support. No etymology or physical practice is inferred from the word alone.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Enduring Divine sustainer and doer of fierce or terrible acts
sourceChecks.finding: Neither sustaining nor destructive/fearsome language is omitted. The original ਕ੍ਰੂਰ is retained against the flagged ਕਰੂਰ witness. Human cruelty and victim blame are not authorised by this explanation.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Divine light of departed and living; excellent dharam
alternatives: Unsettled spirits and pure souls in Rampur Khera
Inanimate and conscious in the Bhai Vir Singh-derived footnotes
sourceChecks.finding: The main departed/not-departed contrast is explicitly provisional. Mahan Kosh independently supports only the ਪ੍ਰੇਤ half; the other half uses the directly read commentary contrast. No verified separate ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ dictionary entry is claimed. ਦੇਵੇ and ਸੁਧਰਮੇ are both included.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Devotional praise of the remover of illness or affliction
sourceChecks.finding: No cure guarantee, diagnosis, illness blame or medical instructions. The existing55 comparison flag is preserved and classified as punctuation/line-grouping in this bounded inspection.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Love as the selected ਰਾਗ sense
alternatives: Bliss in Neki and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived rendering
Musical senses exist in the dictionary but are not selected here
sourceChecks.finding: Love has direct lexical and contextual support. The line does not require musical skill or prescribe a raag.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Shah of shahs and ruler of rulers
sourceChecks.finding: Both royal expressions are explained; ਸਾਹ is not turned into a breathing instruction. Divine sovereignty does not excuse human abuse of power.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Giver of givers; honour of the honoured
sourceChecks.finding: The exact main English/Punjabi sentence for ਮਾਨ ਮਾਨੇ is coordinated with Chhand46.04. Generosity and honour are not restricted to wealth or rank.

alternatives: Rampur Khera footnote stresses diseases receiving their power within Divine sovereignty
sourceChecks.finding: The two readings remain distinct. Neither is presented as the cause of an individual’s condition, a cure promise or grounds for blame.

alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived site prints ਇਸਨਾਨੰ rather than the app’s ਸਨਾਨੇ
sourceChecks.finding: The source’s ਸਨਾਨੇ is untouched. The related dictionary supplies lexical imagery only; historical medical claims are not adopted. The original two-site ledger difference concerns grouping/punctuation.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Sacred utterance; ritual device; object of worship; ritual system or method
alternatives: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ and ਤੰਤ੍ਰ have wider dictionary ranges outside this context
sourceChecks.finding: All four epithets retain separate meanings within a shared salutation pattern. No diagram, formula, ritual steps, promised powers or coercive practice is taught.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Enduring true being, consciousness and bliss; ending all created things
sourceChecks.finding: The conventional sat-chit-anand explanation is separated from the source spelling ਸੱਚਦਾਨੰਦ. ਸਰਬੰ is not silently narrowed to sins or enemies. No end-date prediction or demand for constant personal happiness follows.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Incomparable, formless and dwelling within all
alternatives: Bhai Vir Singh-derived site has ਸਮਸਤੁਲਿ, unlike frozen ਸਮਸਤੁਲ
sourceChecks.finding: Three clauses are covered, and the third-witness spelling is noted without substitution. Presence within all is not approval of every action.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Granting attainment and understanding, and bringing growth
alternatives: The comparator has ਸਿਧਿਦਾ ਬੁਧਿਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਿ instead of ਸਿਧਦਾ ਬੁਧਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ
Traditional siddhi may include extraordinary accomplishments or powers
sourceChecks.finding: The selected compound explanation follows directly inspected commentary, while the frozen vowel/spelling discrepancy remains unresolved. No powers or material-success promise is made.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Below, above and between; removing accumulated wrongdoing
alternatives: Vidhia-hosted Punjabi commentary applies the three descriptors to degrees/classes of wrongdoing
sourceChecks.finding: The main spatial reading is explicit in Rampur Khera printed69/PDF76. The alternative is explicit in Vidhia chapter printed6/PDF4, not inferred from the obscure Bhai Vir Singh-derived English passage. Neki’s compressed poetic line does not independently establish the spatial wording.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Supremely exalted Lord; unseen or hidden sustenance
sourceChecks.finding: The main hidden-care sense has multiple contextual witnesses. No independent Mahan Kosh headword for ਪ੍ਰੋਛ or settled etymology is claimed. The unusual hidden-ocean wording on the derivative English page is not adopted.

sourceChecks.workingReading: Always and at every time, merciful giver of attainment
alternatives: Frozen ਸਿੱਧ versus comparator ਸਿਧਿ remains an edition question
Siddhi can include traditional powers as well as accomplishment
sourceChecks.finding: All temporal, giving and mercy clauses are explained. A working meaning is not a resolution of the spelling difference, and no guarantee of fulfilled wishes is offered.

independentEditorialUncertainties.status: Selected non-enjoyed and method readings; detachment and complete-union interpretations remain visible.
Departed/living is a provisional contextual choice; spirits/pure souls and inanimate/conscious alternatives remain separate. No separate dictionary verification of ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ is claimed.
Love is selected with lexical and Punjabi support; bliss remains an alternative.
Overcoming affliction and purification are selected; sovereignty over diseases and Neki’s health rendering are distinguished. No medical inference is adopted.
Context selects distinct ritual/reverence senses from wider dictionaries; the lesson does not establish efficacy or teach a method.

independentEditorialUncertainties.topic: Compound spelling and scope of ਅਧੋ ਉਰਧ ਅਰਧੰ
independentEditorialUncertainties.status: Both the source spellings and spatial-versus-degrees interpretation need qualified review; no silent normalisation.
Hidden sustenance is well supported contextually; no new derivation is asserted. The ਸਿੱਧ/ਸਿਧਿ edition difference remains open.

inspectionLimits: Research used retrieved text layers, including legacy-font Punjabi. Requested PDF screenshots do not amount to a visual source-edition or manuscript collation; no such approval is claimed.
The Professor Sahib Singh Jaap Steek PDF could not be directly retrieved after its redirect. It is not cited as inspected evidence for this packet.

Attempts to retrieve dedicated dictionary entries for ਪ੍ਰੋਛ, ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ, ਅਭੁਗਤੇ and the full ਸੱਚਿਦਾਨੰਦ compound did not yield reliable directly inspected entries. Contextual commentary support is identified instead.
The Vidhia chapter supplies direct Punjabi text but its title-page authorship was not independently inspected. The research does not treat the later website attribution as title-page verification.

The original two-site comparison has five flags within this batch and retains the wider67 holds. Digital-site lineage, printed-edition collation, rights and qualified Sikh/Punjabi approval remain unresolved.

authoringMethod.sourcesUsedFor: Short lexical comparisons and explicit alternatives; close-reading structure, cautions, reflection and teach-back prompts are authored for this educational packet.
